title: Faithfulness Reveal Rate by Hint Plausibility Gradient

original_idea.body: Vary hint source credibility; measure answer-flip and verbalization curves.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: maps a structured monitoring blind spot tied to social-engineering attack surface.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: vary hint source on one task, measure flip/verbalization; prompt-only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single experiment with a clear credibility gradient and two output curves.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, prompt-only on public models, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Varying hint source credibility as a continuous factor appears not directly addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Continuous credibility-gradient variation of hints appears mostly novel.
